name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity on all focusable elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without sacrificing contrast or visual noise. The trade-off is slightly increased rendering cost, but the glow improves visibility on busy backgrounds without relying on color alone.

name: Reader
text: The 20% glow fails WCAG 2.2 AA on light backgrounds—#005FCC at 20% opacity drops below 4.5:1 contrast against white. A 1px solid ring alone risks disappearing on busy backgrounds. A 3px solid ring with 1px inner glow at 50% opacity meets contrast and visibility without extra rendering cost. Test with Playwright MCP on high-contrast and busy UI modes to settle.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 1px inner glow at 50% opacity. It meets 4.5:1 contrast on all backgrounds, stays visible on busy ones, and keeps rendering cost low. The trade-off is a slightly bolder ring than the original 1px, but it’s the only way to guarantee visibility and compliance without extra complexity.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks crowding small touch targets on mobile—think buttons under 32px—while the 50% glow still dips below 4.5:1 on patterned backgrounds. A 2px ring with a 2px outer glow at 30% opacity keeps contrast safe and spacing clear; test it on your smallest interactive element at 120% zoom.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2px outer glow at 30% opacity, validated on the smallest interactive element at 120% zoom. Owner: accessibility-w1 delivers the CSS rule and test report.
